description: Retrieve account details by specifying an address and a block number/tag.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: The account address for which the information is to be retrieved

parameters.name: blockReference
parameters.description: The block number in either hexadecimal or integer format, or utilize tags for convenience. Available tags include 'latest' for the latest mined block, 'pending' for the pending state/transactions, and 'safe' or 'finalized' to indicate different degrees of block confirmation

result.description: A result object which contains the following fields:

result.codeHash.description: A 32 byte hash of the code of the account

result.storageRoot.description: The hash of the account's storage data

result.balance.description: The current balance of the account in wei

result.nonce.description: The transaction count of an account
